entries.subject: Radius
entries.finding: 1.14 Jupiter radii from the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated radius (its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, since HD 50554 b does not transit, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Mass
entries.finding: 5.85 Jupiter masses: Xiao et al. 2023, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2023RAA....23e5022X), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023RAA....23e5022X/abstract).

entries.subject: Orbit
entries.finding: Xiao et al. 2023 (2023RAA....23e5022X), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname XIAO_ET_AL__2023): P 1240 d; Xiao et al. 2023 (2023RAA....23e5022X), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname XIAO_ET_AL__2023): a/R* from its semi-major axis 2.339 au over the host's recorded radius 1.146 solar radii, so the orbit keeps the paper's size; inclination 61 +12 degrees, measured in the same fit; Xiao et al. 2023 (2023RAA....23e5022X), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname XIAO_ET_AL__2023): e 0.482; Xiao et al. 2023 (2023RAA....23e5022X), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname XIAO_ET_AL__2023): omega 4 degrees; Xiao et al. 2023 (2023RAA....23e5022X), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname XIAO_ET_AL__2023): periastron passage 2455567 BJD, taken as BJD_TDB; Display convention: the NASA Exoplanet Archive carries no position angle for the orbit's node on the sky, so the ascending node is set at position angle 0 (celestial north)..
